Day 22 of #CloudSecurity: EKS security fundamentals

The scariest EKS default: no network policies. Every pod can reach every other pod.

Minimal fix:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
```

Apply per namespace, then selectively open paths. Also: enable IRSA, enforce restricted pod security standards, and turn on audit logging.
